Strong presentation skills and ability to skillfully interact with technical stakeholders as well as executive decision makers. Success in owning and running the entire sales cycle from lead generation to close with a disciplined approach / methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Challenger, Sandler, etc).
